purpose: Statistical ARM versus PL latency comparison on the same board, model and inputs
scope: 33 operators; PL includes PS register programming and completion polling; both paths exclude model load, input preparation and output extraction
design: calibration microkernels; main phase: shipped scalar reference (arm_novec) versus PL over 3 inputs, 12 interleaved rounds each; sensitivity phase: -O0 / -O3-novec / -O3-vec / PL on one input, 6 rounds
